evidence: Labeled Consensus and directly modifies the script interpreter (src/script/interpreter.cpp) to implement BIP-119 template verification.
rationale: Provides in-tree consensus verification logic on regtest so developers can experiment with covenant protocols and multi-proposal compositions without out-of-tree builds. While the underlying BIP-119 opcode is a major proposed consensus rule requiring careful review, limiting deployment strictly to regtest positions this as a strategic experimentation capability rather than an urgent network consensus decision.
